title: The Saturation Trap and the Subjectivity of Intervention Timing: Why Affect-Based Triggers and LLM Judges Fail to Time Interventions on Autonomous Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.04296v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As autonomous AI agents move from conversational systems to long-horizon software execution, runtime safety layers that decide when to interrupt an agent have become essential. We study this timing problem using a continuous 18-dimensional affective-dynamics engine (HEART) as a diagnostic probe, evaluating four intervention trigger families - absolute state thresholds, composite state-action patterns, regex reasoning-feature extraction, and zero-shot LLM-as-judge - against human-annotated intervention points on SWE-bench-Verified debugging traces. We report three findings. First, a State Saturation Trap: modeled frustration quickly crosses the threshold and stays at its maximum (v2 erratum: the observer could not register recovery; decay never ran), converting threshold-on-state triggers from moment detectors into near-constant indicators that fire on 39-83% of actions across five trajectories. Second, a capability-and-context floor

translated_title: 饱和陷阱与干预时机的主观性：基于情感的触发器与大语言模型裁判为何无法为自主智能体的干预把握恰当时机
translated_abstract: 随着自主AI智能体从对话系统转向长时程软件执行，决定何时中断智能体的运行时安全层已变得不可或缺。我们以一个连续的18维情感动力学引擎（HEART）作为诊断探针来研究这一时机问题，在SWE-bench-Verified调试轨迹上，将四类干预触发器——绝对状态阈值、复合“状态-动作”模式、基于正则表达式的推理特征提取，以及零样本"LLM-as-judge"（大语言模型裁判）——与人工标注的干预点进行对比评估。我们报告了三项发现。第一，状态饱和陷阱：被建模的挫折感迅速越过阈值并停留在最大值（v2勘误：观察者无法记录恢复过程；衰减从未运行），使得“基于状态的阈值”触发器从“时刻检测器”退化为近乎恒定的指示器，在五条轨迹上对39%–83%的动作触发。第二，能力与情境下限……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究以18维情感动力学引擎HEART作为诊断探针，揭示了“状态饱和陷阱”等机制，说明基于情感的触发器和大语言模型裁判无法准确把握中断自主智能体的干预时机。
en_tdlr: Using an 18-dimensional affective-dynamics engine (HEART) as a diagnostic probe, this study reveals a "State Saturation Trap" and other failure modes explaining why affect-based triggers and LLM-as-judge fail to time interventions on autonomous agents.
